title: Foundations of the Theory of Probability
author: A. N. Kolmogorov
context: A. N. Kolmogorov, "Foundations of the Theory of Probability", Chelsea Publishing Company, New York, 1950 — Nathan Morrison's English translation of the 1933 German "Grundbegriffe der Wahrscheinlichkeitsrechnung". A measure- theoretic monograph: axiomatic probability, Borel fields, Lebesgue integration, conditional probability and expectation, laws of large numbers.
